item.title: Large dips and cracks in paving slabs very dangerous, 18th September
item.description:
It is across the entire pavement stretching from 21 - 23 dowty road. The dips in the slabs where cracked are deep and I have often had to provide passers by with wet paper towels for their crying children's knees. Unfortunately a lot of necessary works have been carried out along that stretch by BT last year. The whole grass verge was dug up, seeds were out down by them afterwards but never grew. Now Severn Trent look to be planning to also turn up the mud again. I don't believe the paving slabs will cope with many more diggers or ground movement as it will only cause them to worsen further.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 21, Dowty Road, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: No give way to cycle lane sign, 18th September
item.description:
Hello, I was wondering if it would be worth putting up a give way sign on this junction. It appears that priority should be with the cycle/pedestrian crossing. However, in reality few cars actually give way at this junction. And due to the reduced visibility around the junction it makes it very dangerous. Cars approach very quickly and either have to brake harshly or just do not stop. Today I received abuse from a driver who did not stop and give way to the cycle lane. Would it be possible to erect a give way sign either side of the bike lane so that drivers know they should stop when approaching.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 141, Tennyson Road, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
